tagline: An endless sky-high bounce: Pip the cloud rabbit bounces on her own; steer her into letters, slam for a super spring, and blow away the rain.
overview:
Pip Cloud Post is an endless 2D survival game in a bright paper-and-cloud sky, one of the three Date Night Arcade games. Pip, a scarf-wearing cloud rabbit who delivers the sky's post, bounces up and down by herself; you steer her left and right to collect floating envelopes.

Press A to slam down for a super spring that sends her higher, and B to blow a gust that clears nearby rain. Storms grow faster and denser every 20 seconds. You have four hearts; survive as long as you can and beat your own best.
story: Pip is the sky's postal rabbit, bouncing between clouds to collect the letters blowing about up there. The weather is not on her side: the longer she works, the harder it storms.
goal: Survive as long as you can and collect as many letters as possible: there is no end, only your best score and longest run.
rules: Pip bounces on her own; you steer her left and right.
A slams down: the next bounce is a super spring.
B blows a gust that clears the rain near Pip.
You have four hearts; each hit costs one. When they are gone the run is over.
Every 20 seconds a new wave starts, faster and busier than the last.
Your score, survival time, best scores and a rank (Rookie, Quick Feet, Chain Ace, Superstar, Arcade Legend) are saved.
